name: bulkappearance-simple
description: Simple rung for the bulkAppearance flag (IXT-SUITES batch 6): tier:'simple', default-on 'Tint all' block in MultiSelectPanel. Seeds 2 items + a 2-item selection, asserts the Appearance section mounts, hides when the flag is forced off, reappears when re-enabled, drives the real Hex colour input to bulk-recolour both items, then clicks 'Clear tint' to reset both.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: seed-two-items-and-select
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([]); const id1 = s.addItem({ defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9.5, 3.5], rotation: 0, props: {} }); const id2 = s.addItem({ defId: 'armchair', position: [11.5, 4.5], rotation: 0, props: {} }); window.__ms_ids = [id1, id2]; s.setSelectedItemIds([id1, id2]); })()

steps.name: multiselect-panel-visible
steps.failMessage: MultiSelectPanel did not mount after selecting 2 items

steps.name: assert-appearance-section-present-simple
steps.failMessage: 'Tint all' appearance section should be present in Simple mode (bulkAppearance is tier:simple, default:true)

steps.name: assert-appearance-section-hidden
steps.failMessage: 'Tint all' section should disappear once bulkAppearance is force-disabled

steps.name: assert-appearance-section-restored
steps.failMessage: 'Tint all' section should reappear once bulkAppearance is re-enabled

steps.name: hex-field-visible
steps.failMessage: Colour popover's hex field did not open

steps.name: set-hex-value
steps.eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector("input[aria-label='Hex colour']"); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, '#ff8800'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-both-items-tinted

waitFor.store: (() => { const ids = window.__ms_ids; const items = state.items.filter(i => ids.includes(i.id)); return items.length === 2 && items.every(i => (i.props.tint || '').toLowerCase() === '#ff8800'); })()

steps.failMessage: Both selected items should carry the bulk-applied tint #ff8800

steps.name: clear-tint-visible
steps.failMessage: 'Clear tint' button did not appear once items carry a tint

steps.name: assert-both-items-cleared

waitFor.store: (() => { const ids = window.__ms_ids; const items = state.items.filter(i => ids.includes(i.id)); return items.length === 2 && items.every(i => (i.props.tint || '') === ''); })()

steps.failMessage: Both selected items should have their tint cleared after 'Clear tint'
